intent.goal: Find content in the Trass workspace related to maker

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, c.metadata, '') as content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
LEFT JOIN generic_content c ON u.page_id = c.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('journal', 'stories', 'cpj')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%maker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%maker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%maker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(c.metadata, '')) LIKE '%maker%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
